dog.description_text:
Meet Clyde — the handsome love bug with a heart full of sweetness.

Affectionate, gentle, and impossible not to adore, Clyde has a way of brightening every moment just by being near.

He came to us from Mississippi after the shelter there could no longer care for him, putting him at risk. We stepped in and gave him the second chance he deserved, and now he’s safe and ready to start his next chapter.

Clyde is looking for a family who will cherish him for the lovable boy he is. If you’re searching for a loyal, snuggly companion with looks and heart to match, Clyde is your guy. Please consider adopting him and giving him the forever home he’s been hoping for.

All dogs will be altered, microchipped, and receive age-appropriate vaccines prior to adoption.

Interested in adopting or fostering? Need more info on this dog? The first step in the process is filling out an application on our website.
